The '''Coruscant Lodge of Solokin Sakellar''' was a [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was owned by [[Solokin Sakellar/Legends|Solokin Sakellar]], the [[Grand Warden/Legends|Grand Warden]] of the [[University of Yabol Opa/Legends|University of Yabol Opa]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>
